summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments from automated reviewers (CodeRabbit) on the current branch, implementing fixes and replying to/resolving each thread.
summary.outcome: Three CodeRabbit review comments were addressed in commit 0a8acb9: a timeout budget mismatch, missing E2E_RUN_ID validation, and a missing default on DESKTOP_TOTAL. A follow-up commit fixed additional concerns about log message wording and fallback behavior when the ci-e2e.yml run itself failed.

repo: release-gate.yml orchestrates E2E test result aggregation and uses E2E_RUN_ID to correlate runs — this variable must be validated after poll loops complete.
DESKTOP_TOTAL and similar count variables need ':-0' defaults for safe arithmetic in shell expressions.
Timeout budget in release-gate.yml must be set to 60 minutes to match the actual workflow duration.

code.finding: E2E_RUN_ID null/empty guard must be added after both poll loops, not just one, to prevent silent fallback on failed ci-e2e.yml runs.
DESKTOP_TOTAL should use ${DESKTOP_TOTAL:-0} for consistency with other count variables to avoid unbound variable errors.

workflow: CodeRabbit review threads must be resolved via GraphQL mutation (resolveReviewThread) after replying via REST API — these are separate operations.
When replying to PR comments via gh api, use --field for integer parameters (in_reply_to) and --raw-field for string bodies.
Triage review comments before implementing: categorize as 'valid fix needed', 'already addressed', or 'not applicable' to avoid unnecessary changes.

friction: The review comment workflow requires two separate API calls per thread: one REST call to reply and one GraphQL mutation to resolve — no single combined operation.
